name: ICAR 2026 — International Congress for Ataxia Research (國際共濟失調研究大會)
location: 美國亞特蘭大 Renaissance Atlanta Waverly
relevance: 共濟失調領域最重要的專門研究大會，由 NAF、FARA、Ataxia Global Initiative 與 Ataxia UK 四方共同主辦；基礎機轉、自然史世代、臨床評估量表與競品臨床數據集中發表於此。對本公司而言是 SCA 領域能見度與 KOL 接觸密度最高的單一場合；註冊與摘要投稿自 2026/03/04 開放。

en.name: ICAR 2026 — International Congress for Ataxia Research
en.relevance: The most important dedicated research congress in the ataxia field, hosted jointly by NAF, FARA, the Ataxia Global Initiative and Ataxia UK; basic mechanism, natural history cohorts, clinical rating scales and competitor clinical data are all concentrated here. For Steminent it is the single venue with the highest density of SCA visibility and KOL contact. Registration and abstract submission opened 2026/03/04.

name: BioAsia Taiwan — Cell Therapy Leadership Forum
relevance: 細胞治療臨床轉譯、法規、CMC、GMP 製造與國際合作。本公司共同主辦。

en.relevance: Clinical translation, regulation, CMC, GMP manufacturing and international partnering in cell therapy. Co-hosted by Steminent.

name: MDS International Congress (國際動作障礙學會年會)
relevance: 動作障礙領域最大國際年會；SCA／共濟失調臨床與競品發表重鎮。

en.name: MDS International Congress
en.relevance: The largest international meeting in movement disorders; a key venue for SCA/ataxia clinical and competitor presentations.

name: World Orphan Drug Congress Europe (WODC)
relevance: 罕病／孤兒藥旗艦會議。本公司 2025/04 曾於 WODC 發表 Ph2。

en.relevance: Flagship rare-disease/orphan-drug meeting. Steminent presented its Ph2 at WODC in 2025/04.

name: NAF Annual Ataxia Conference (美國共濟失調基金會年會)
location: 美國拉斯維加斯 Planet Hollywood
relevance: SCA 病友、研究者與藥廠齊聚；競品常於此揭露臨床進度。下屆會議日期與地點已由官網公布。

en.name: NAF Annual Ataxia Conference
en.location: Planet Hollywood, Las Vegas, NV, USA
en.relevance: Brings together SCA patients, researchers and companies; competitors often disclose clinical progress here. The next meeting's date and venue have been posted on the organiser's site.

name: ISSCR Annual Meeting (國際幹細胞研究學會年會)
location: 美國舊金山 Moscone West Convention Center
relevance: 幹細胞與再生醫學旗艦會議（本公司 MSC 領域）。下屆（2027）日期與地點已由官網公布。

en.name: ISSCR Annual Meeting
en.location: Moscone West Convention Center, San Francisco, CA, USA
en.relevance: Flagship stem-cell and regenerative-medicine meeting (our MSC field). The 2027 date and venue have been posted on the organiser's site.
